## Summary
What changed, and why was it needed? Link any related issues.

## Verification
List the exact checks you ran and their results. Say which used scripted
fixtures and which used a live model.

## Compatibility and security
Describe any API or configuration changes. Note side effects, permission
changes, and anything that affects deployment.

## Checklist
- [ ] The change stays focused and follows the design principles in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- [ ] Behavioral changes have regression tests.
- [ ] I updated the relevant docs, examples, and CHANGELOG.md.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or generated build artifacts are included.
- [ ] I listed any checks I skipped or that failed.
